sentences.text: CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MOHAMMAD NAWAZ
ORAL ORDER

The registration of FIR in Crime No.28/2024 at Kalaburagi City Women Police Station, for the offence punishable under Section 498(A) read with Section 34 of IPC is sought to be quashed by the petitioners.

02. Heard the learned counsel for petitioners, the learned High Court Government Pleader and the learned counsel for respondent No.2 / defacto complainant.
03.

In the complaint lodged by respondent No.2, she has averred that her marriage with accused No.1 took place about 05 years prior to lodging of the complaint and since 02 years i.e., from 20.02.2022, she is living in her parental home situated at Shaikh Roza, Kalaburagi.
Her grievance is that her husband and his relatives have not taken her back to her matrimonial home, in spite of a panchayat conducted by the village elders.

The learned High Court Government Pleader has contended that investigation is completed and charge- sheet has been filed against accused Nos.1 to 5.
05.
Petitioners are arraigned as accused Nos.3 and 4 respectively.
They are the sister and uncle of complainant's husband, who is arraigned as accused No.1 in this case.
Vague allegations are made in the FIR that all the accused have made the complainant's life miserable.

06. The learned counsel for respondent No.2 - defacto complainant would contend that though the accused have promised the complainant that she will be taken back to her matrimonial home,
instead of fulfilling the said promise, they have blocked her phone number.
However, the same cannot be said to be harassment or cruelty.
There are no specific allegations against these petitioners which would attract the definition of cruelty, to initiate criminal proceeding under Section 498(A) of IPC.
Moreover, admittedly these petitioners are residing separately.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Kahkashan Kausar alias Sonam and others vs. State of Bihar and Others1 has held that the Courts should be careful in proceeding against the distant relatives in crimes pertaining to matrimonial disputes and must keep in mind that relatives of the husband should not be roped in on the basis of omnibus allegations unless specific instances of their involvement in the crime are made out.

sentences.text: Having perused the entire material on record, I am of the considered view that the proceedings initiated against the petitioners are nothing but an abuse of process of Court.
Accordingly, the following; (2022) 6 SCC 599 NC: 2024:KHC-K:8368 ORDER I.
The petition is allowed.

II. The entire proceedings arising out of Crime No.28/2024 of Kalaburagi City Women Police Station, insofar as petitioners - accused Nos.3 and 4 are concerned, are hereby quashed.
